description: A line starting with an interpolation leaves <<- indentation in the parsed template
notes: The spec says the literal text at the start of each line is analyzed and doesn't say what happens when a line starts with an interpolation or directive instead. hashicorp/hcl counts such a line as having no leading spaces, so nothing is removed from any line (flushHeredocTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go). Leaving the line out of the analysis would give "a\nb\n".
